name: Nerium
source:
The young and dastardly dryad Nerium unabashedly considers himself a bad guy and feels no shame in all the wrongdoing he commits. He only desires the most amazing of things. According to himself, at least. If someone as fantastic as him has deemed it worthy to have, it must be fantastic by default. Nerium has a massive amount of natural power and that is what's gotten him this far. It’s definitely not any talent for thinking things through.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=43343]Lemma Soft Forum thread[/url]]
